execution.ref: candidate-fault policy digest calculation through Ubuntu-24.04
execution.description: Attempted to use the existing Linux Python environment to calculate the canonical policy digest.

expected: The registered policy digest is calculated by the same canonical JSON algorithm used at load.
observed: The managed Windows session denied WSL service access before Python started, so the attempt produced no digest evidence.
keep: The digest remains generated from parsed canonical JSON rather than file line endings.
change: Use the available host Python launcher for deterministic metadata generation and reserve canonical Linux execution for tests when WSL access is available.
